segments.name: Advertising service
segments.description: Provides advertising services connecting advertisers with media; the company's only reportable segment.
segments.evidence: Since the Company operates in one reportable segment, all financial information required can be found in the consolidated financial statements.

revenueModel.text: Advertisers pay the company for advertising services rendered to them, mainly in China.
revenueModel.evidence: Accounts receivable are typically unsecured and derived from services rendered to advertisers that are located primarily in China, thereby exposed to credit risk.
